newsitem.title: CANADA: Ford to pay C$117.91/shr to Canada dissenters.
newsitem.headline: Ford to pay C$117.91/shr to Canada dissenters.

text.p: Ford Motor Co said on Thursday it would pay C$117.91 a share to Ford Motor Co of Canada shareholders who were disputing the car company's evaluation of Ford Canada shares.
Ford said it was making the interim payment pending the outcome of an appeal by Ford against an order to pay shareholders C$185 a share.
The company said the Ontario court judge whose ruling was being appealed suggested that Ford make the interim payment.
Ford Canada is wholly owned by Ford Motor Co. It was formerly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange and 94 percent-owned by Ford.

Ford offered to acquire the six percent of Ford Canada's shares that it did not own, but its fair valuation assessed the shares betweeen C$110 and C$150 each. The minority shareholders said the shares were worth C$185 a share.
